issue.title: Capture & consumption deletes emptied (even running) Pomodoros without reporting them

task_type_fields.impact:
- A `bob capture` `&` (and Bob Mac Capture, which renders bob's preview) can delete the running timed Pomodoro and remove Task Link subtrees with no visible preview.
- The proposed `*` capture syntax (research:202610/capture_star_blocks_syntax__cld.md) makes this the common case.
- Fix: report consumed links as a structured field (`{pomodoro, line, running, link, task}`), report emptied or removed entries (especially the running one) in `pomodoro_blocks` or an equivalent, and name the session in human output.
task_type_fields.repro:
Repro (throwaway vault; `.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-tasks-plugin/data.json` copied from ~/bob):

- `job.md`: `- [/] #task Do cleanup tasks! [created::2026-10-14] ^cleanup`
- `bob.md`: `- [ ] #task Ask Kelly for references! [created::2026-10-14] ^ask-kelly`
- `2026/20261014.md` `## Pomodoros`: a closed `🍅 [[job#^cleanup]]` entry, a **running** `- [ ] (**1010-1035** [t:: 25m]) — JOB` whose only child is `[[job#^cleanup]]`, and a `- [ ] () — BLOG` placeholder.

`BOB_NOW=2026-10-14T10:20 bob capture -b VAULT -f json --dry-run -- '&bob:ask-kelly @job+cleanup'`

- The JSON has no `pomodoro_blocks` key. The only signal is `warnings: ["removed 1 live Pomodoro link(s) to newly Blocked task(s)"]` plus `plan_budget.themes` dropping from 2 to 1.
- A live run deletes the running JOB session outright. Human output prints only the same one-line warning.
- Same result when the emptied entry is a future placeholder (`&bob:ask-kelly @job+other`).
- On the real vault, `bob capture --dry-run '&bob:star-block-capture @job_2026_apply_20+do-cleanup-tasks'` would delete today's running 1010-1035 JOB session, and the output does not say so.

Root cause:
- `consume_live_links` (`src/native/capture/project_deps.rs`:266-317) returns `PomodoroBlockRef::removed` refs.
- `PomodoroBlockRef::removed` (`src/native/capture/pomodoro_blocks.rs`:93-102) is documented to "never report the entry itself".
- The consumed links have no structured field; `plan_existing_task_dependencies` only pushes a warning (`src/native/capture/dependencies.rs`:2466-2473).
- Reconcile already reports the same pass as `consumed_blocked_references` (`docs/task-status-hooks.md` "Blocked task links are consumed").

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching the * capture syntax: a & add that blocks a linked task silently removes its Task Links and can delete the running session, with only a warning string in output.
